# LinkedPhone email hub

**Open the hub: https://pravarbubby.github.io/linkedphone-email-hub/**

Review every LinkedPhone onboarding and transactional email in one place:

- Browse emails by customer journey (onboarding series, signing up, number setup, alerts, billing, payment problems).
- Preview each email on desktop and phone, in light and dark mode, across versions V1–V8.
- Edit the text and see it update live.
- Download any email as a single HTML file, with sample names or ready to send.

This repository holds the published hub only; it is hosted on GitHub Pages from the `main` branch.
